name: JW Marriott Resort Kaafu Atoll Island
positioning: Private-island resort (officially JW Marriott Maldives Kaafu Atoll Island Resort) a 15-minute speedboat ride from Velana International Airport, with overwater and beach villas that each have a private pool, an overwater spa and Safeeru butler service
best_for: Couples who want a private-pool villa over the lagoon or on the beach without a long transfer
Families who want a kids club, splash park and family villas
Spa lovers drawn to an overwater spa using BABOR skincare

facts.text: The resort is on Hathaa Finolhu in Kaafu Atoll, a 15-minute speedboat ride from Velana International Airport.
The resort was designed by architect Cuneyt Bukulmez of Turkey-based Atolye4N.
The arrival jetty is inspired by the flight of the Maakana, the great grey heron.
The overwater villas have direct lagoon access and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Villa bathrooms have both indoor and outdoor showers.
The Ocean Residence has its own spa treatment room, a personal gym and a water slide into the lagoon.
The main pool is framed by the ocean and white sandy beach, with a lap pool and a kids' pool alongside.
The Family by JW Kids Club has a treehouse where kids can climb walls and swing from the ceiling, and there is a Splash Park for water play.
The resort has a Water Sports and Dive Center, and every villa offers direct access to the sea.
Destination dining includes private sandbank lunches and starlit dinners.
The restaurants use produce from the resort's own island JW Garden.

highlights.text: The villas draw inspiration from traditional Gedhoru island homes, with thatched kajan roofs and turquoise doors.
Every villa has a private pool, whether over the lagoon or on the beach.
Spa by JW is set over the water, with six treatment rooms, a steam room, sauna and jacuzzi, and uses BABOR skincare, offered for the first time in the Maldives.
Guests are looked after by a Safeeru, a butler role rooted in the traditions of the Maldivian Sultanate era.
The resort works with INVENA and MIT's Self Assembly Lab on an underwater structure to reduce beach erosion and create reef habitat.

considerations.text: Third-party transfers to the resort are not permitted; arrival is by the resort's own speedboat transfers.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.
